response.overview: Vauban, a historic neighborhood in Marseille’s old town, overlooked by Notre-Dame de la Garde is revealed to us through the eyes, memories, and fears of its lifelong residents. In this documentary, nostalgia and love for their rapidly changing home neighborhood accompany a young person discovering its steep, colorful streets, its stairways, and the ups and downs that define Vauban’s unique identity.
response.title: Vauban , Notre quartier
